resources.string: Jancar ivi-services not found. This screen controls the audio processor of a Jancar head unit (ROHM BD37534 / BU32107, AKM AK7604) and is not available on this device.

Moves the sound between the four speakers. This is done by the head unit audio processor, after Android and ViPER.

• Balance — left / right.
• Fader — front / rear.
Bass, middle and treble controls of the head unit audio processor. They apply to every source (radio, Bluetooth, Android), unlike ViPER effects which only process Android audio.

Equalizer built into the head unit audio processor (DSP boards: ROHM BU32107, AKM AK7604). The number of bands and their frequencies come from the chip. On the ROHM BD37534 the equalizer is the Tone section (3 bands).
Loudness (bass and treble boost at low volume), subwoofer level and filters, and listening position presets of the audio processor. Only the settings your chip supports are shown.
Per-speaker delay (time alignment) so that the sound of every speaker reaches the listening position at the same time. Only available on DSP boards (ROHM BU32107, AKM AK7604).
